findings.description: The customer-managed key that protects the audit bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic key rotation is disabled (AWS default). Key material therefore remains in use indefinitely, meaning a compromised or leaked key stays valid and maximizes the blast radius of a key compromise; this also fails standard benchmarks such as CIS AWS 3.8.
